definitions.explanation: Used in business and administrative contexts to describe tasks or matters not yet completed.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{案件|あんけん}→案件：13109_anken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{未了|みりょう}だ。
{未了|みりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{済|す}ませて→済む：01950_sumu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please complete the outstanding procedures as soon as possible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{未了|みりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{放置|ほうち}→放置：12826_houchi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are buildings left abandoned with construction unfinished.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ (not yet) + {了|りょう} (completion). A formal word used in business, legal, and administrative settings to indicate that something remains incomplete or unresolved.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未了|みりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{案件|あんけん}→案件：13109_anken⟧: pending matter
- {未了|みりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: outstanding procedures
- ⟦{審議|しんぎ}→審議：19112_shingi⟧{未了|みりょう}: deliberation not completed
- ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧{未了|みりょう}: construction incomplete

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{未完|みかん}→未完：17862_mikan⟧: unfinished (especially creative works like novels or paintings)
- {未済|みさい}: unsettled, unpaid (financial contexts)
- {未完了|みかんりょう}: incomplete (grammatical term or general use)
- ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧: in progress, midway (more neutral and conversational)
